current_player_lifetimes.scope: Conservative reaching definitions separate nonescaping ordinary int value groups. Shared reads and read/modify/write uses merge groups; entry/uninitialized and opaque-write groups cannot acquire names. Each renamed group has a player-selection role and direct non-inline native int32 local vocabulary. Every definition has a player-valued origin and a player-argument or per-player array use supports its domain. C member names retain their separate namespace and ordinary identifiers cannot be captured. Merging the new bindings reproduces every predecessor byte. All actual expanded units match. Native optimized-variable identity and new function coverage are not claimed; no gameplay tests.
